match_form.en: Match each word to its meaning.

match_coll.en: Match the two halves to make a collocation.

sort.en: Put each item in the correct group.

pick.en: Choose the correct answer for each one.

odd.en: One item does not belong. Tap it.

type_gap.en: Complete the sentences. Write one word.

nobank.en: There is no word box — write the word yourself.

wform.en: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.

bank.en: Complete the sentences. Use the words in the box.

cloze.en: Complete the text. Use the words in the box.

recall.en: Cover the definitions and write the word from memory.

rule.en: Read the explanation and the examples before you practise.

notice.en: Look back at the text. Then answer the question.

drop.en: Choose the correct option in each gap.

trans.en: Rewrite the sentence. Use the words given.

ttrans.en: Rewrite the sentence so that it means the same. Use the word given.

chain.en: Rewrite the sentence twice, one step at a time.

fix.en: One word or phrase is wrong. Tap it.

epara.en: There are mistakes in this paragraph. Tap each one.

worked.en: Read the worked example. Then do the same.

r_gist.en: Read the text quickly. Answer the questions.

r_tf.en: Read the text. Then choose True or False.

r_detail.en: Read the text again. Choose the correct answer.

r_find.en: Find the word or phrase in the text that means…

r_form.en: Find the target form in the text.

r_second.en: Read the second text. Then answer the questions.

r_compare.en: Compare the two texts. Choose the correct answer.

model_read.en: Read the model. You are going to write one like it.

model_parts.en: Match each part of the model to its job.

model_phrase.en: Find the phrase in the model that does each job.

model_reg.en: Which version fits this genre? Choose.

l_tf.en: Listen. Then choose True or False.

l_order.en: Listen. Put the events in the order they happen.

l_seq.en: Listen. Put the lines in the order you hear them.

l_match.en: Listen. Match the speaker to the idea.

v_gist.en: Watch the video. Answer the questions.

v_detail.en: Watch again. Choose the correct answer.

twice.en: You can play it as often as you like.

respond.en: Read the situation. Choose the best thing to say.

chat.en: Complete the conversation. Use the words in the box.

nocheck.en: No right or wrong answer here.

quiz.en: Answer all the questions. You will get a score at the end.

test.en: Forty questions on the last twelve lessons. The pass mark is 28.
